title: Conference Management Toolkit
description: A full-stack conference management platform for handling paper submissions, peer reviews, and conference workflows. Features include author and reviewer dashboards, submission tracking, role-based access control for organizers, and automated review assignment with status notifications.

title: School Management System
description: A comprehensive school management application using React.js and Next.js with student registration, QR code ID card generation, and automated report card system. Features Firebase Authentication and Firestore for real-time data sync, plus an Excel-style interface for bulk report card creation with automatic grade calculations and print-ready templates.

title: Real-time Chat Application
description: A real-time messaging application using React.js and Next.js with event-driven architecture for instant message delivery and user presence tracking. Integrated Google authentication and Firebase backend services with WebSocket connections for real-time communication and message persistence.

title: Expense Tracker
description: A comprehensive expense tracking application that helps users monitor their spending habits. Features include expense categorization, budget management, visual charts, and financial insights to promote better money management.
